headlines.name: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
headlines.headline: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
headlines.description: Anthropic is launching some new Claude AI features to help software engineers ship code. As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests. Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Claude's code review capabilities thanks to the Code Review feature, which was announced in March and became generally available in October .

headlines.name: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety
headlines.headline: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety
headlines.description: Joan Spalding has driven the steep, winding road that leads to her house outside Denver for more than 50 years. But these days, the 89-year-old barely touches the steering wheel or the pedals. Instead she tells the car where she wants to go, and presses a button on the large touch-screen in the dashboard of her Tesla Model Y. “I just get in and go,” Spalding says.
